what: When it reaches the 80% line of the screen it snaps into place in jerky steps with no in-betweens, like a paper doll. Position goes from 12% of its own size below to 0, and tilt steps +5°→-5°→0° with steps(2). An entrance as if hand-placing cut-out hearts, illustrations and photo panels.

options.x: Distance of entry from the side (% of own width), default 0 — -12 when coming from the left
options.y: Distance coming from below (% of own height), default 12 — 0 means tilt only
options.steps: Number of stepped stops, default 2 — with 3 it shakes once more, like -5°·+5°·-5°·0°
options.deg: Slope at each step = ±10 × deg (degrees), default -.5 — at .5 the starting direction is reversed
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default top 80% · none means right on attach (hero header heart)
options.fade: Transparent 0 → 1 duration (seconds), default 0 (opacity stays as is) — position arrives in steps but opacity stays smooth. City .8
options.alt: Odd-step tilt, default flip (opposite side ±10×deg) — with zero it stands straight at 0° then tilts again (walking steps)

from.where: Original vendor-Animation (paper sheet wobble) — subpage header heart (y 12 · steps 2 · 1s · deg -.5 · immediate), first page keyword heart (x ±12 · steps 2 · .8s · deg -.5), culture heart (x 12 · steps 3 · 1.4s · deg .5) and photo (x -12 · steps 2 · 1s · deg -.5 · delayed .2s), About activity hearts (yellow x -12 y -8 steps 2 1s · green x 12 y -8 steps 3 1.5s) — these map to the data-wobble·NH.wobble spots in the site
